verdict.rationale: monday.com's own docs say it can automate status updates and reports on a set schedule. Its developer platform ships cron out of the box and can run workflows on real-time events such as item creation or column changes, which covers both the schedule and recurring-event paths of the story. The evidence is mostly short marketing-level statements, so depth is unproven. Missing for 10: detailed docs on configuring recurring schedules (frequency, time zones, limits), and independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled workflows run reliably.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work
